entities.name: Nana Akua Owusu Afriyieh

entities.summary: Nana Akua Owusu Afriyieh is a Ghanaian politician and a member of the New Patriotic Party. She is currently Ghana's Deputy Ambassador to China. She was the Member of Parliament for Ablekuma North constituency.
